description: Turn any public web page into clean Markdown with its title and metadata, without ads, menus or scripts. One HTTP call, ideal for agents that read the web. Use it when: You have a URL and need its readable text for an LLM. Not for: Pages behind a login, or crawling a whole site. Returns: Title, canonical URL, language, Open Graph data and the page body as Markdown. Typical time: about 8 s. Price: $0.006 per page, charged only on success. One call = one web page as clean text.

url.description: Full URL of a public web page, starting with https://
